name: io.github.stabgan/openrouter-multimodal
description: Chat with 300+ LLMs via OpenRouter. Analyze and generate images, audio, and video from MCP.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key. Get one free at https://openrouter.ai/keys

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_DEFAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Default model for chat + analyze tools. Defaults to google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Sandbox root for save_path on generate_* tools. Defaults to the current working directory.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_INPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Local read sandbox for analyze_* file paths. Falls back to OPENROUTER_OUTPUT_DIR, then cwd.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_ALLOW_UNSAFE_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable input/output path sandboxes (legacy v2 behavior).

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_INLINE_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Global inline media ceiling (bytes) for tool results when save_path is unset. Default 1048576 (1 MiB).

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_IMAGE_INLINE_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Image inline ceiling (bytes). Falls back to OPENROUTER_INLINE_MAX_BYTES.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_AUDIO_INLINE_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Audio inline ceiling (bytes). Falls back to OPENROUTER_INLINE_MAX_BYTES.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_VIDEO_INLINE_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Video inline ceiling (bytes). Default 10485760 (10 MiB).

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_MAX_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Default max_tokens for chat_completion when unset in the request.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_SORT
environmentVariables.description: price / throughput / latency

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_IGNORE
environmentVariables.description: CSV of provider slugs to exclude.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: JSON array or CSV of provider slugs to allow (prefer over ignore).

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_ORDER
environmentVariables.description: JSON array or CSV of preferred provider IDs.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_QUANTIZATIONS
environmentVariables.description: CSV of quantization levels (fp16,int8).

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_REQUIRE_PARAMETERS
environmentVariables.description: true/false. Require providers to support all request params.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_DATA_COLLECTION
environmentVariables.description: allow/deny

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_ALLOW_FALLBACKS
environmentVariables.description: true/false

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_CACHE_RESPONSES
environmentVariables.description: Enable response caching server-wide. Sends X-OpenRouter-Cache: true on every chat/analyze call unless overridden per-request. Zero tokens billed on cache hits.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_INCLUDE_REASONING
environmentVariables.description: Enable reasoning tokens passthrough server-wide. Adds _meta.reasoning to chat_completion responses for DeepSeek R1 / Gemini Thinking / Opus 4.7.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_MODEL_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Model list cache TTL in milliseconds. Default 3600000 (1 hour).

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Server log level: error, warn, info, or debug.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_MAX_RESULT_TEXT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Cap text in chat/rerank tool results (chars). Default 512000. Set 0 to disable.

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_ASYNC_JOBS_MEMORY_MAX
environmentVariables.description: In-memory async chat jobs before eviction. Default 200. Set 0 to disable cap.

environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key. Get one free at https://openrouter.ai/keys
